docs.t003: Use according to their respective capabilities.
docs.t004: The website provides official online creation, account history, and purchase of credits; the client can connect to self-hosted models or use account credits after enabling official services. Both sides can generate pure poetry sharing images, but history, saves, and settings are not shared.
docs.t018: The website is browser-oriented: after logging in with a verified email, you can
docs.t025: It strictly uses official generation services and account credits, and does not support self-hosted API keys or local model configurations.
docs.t026: There is no guest creation portal; logged-out users can browse the homepage, usage instructions, pricing details, and the download page.
docs.t027: Website history belongs to the account and does not automatically sync with the client's local history.
docs.t030: Select a photo and submit for official generation
docs.t031: Register using your email address and log in after completing the verification code validation.
docs.t032: Select a JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF image on the creation page. After selection, the image is only previewed and processed locally in the browser; it will not be uploaded immediately.
docs.t033: After clicking generate, the browser re-encodes the photo to JPEG, removes the original EXIF data, and then submits the official asynchronous task.
docs.t034: You can pause querying on this page while waiting for results; the server-side task will not be canceled as a result. You can also continue querying the original task or retry with the same ID.
docs.t035: Original images up to 25 MiB and 40 million pixels; locally scaled to a maximum long edge of 2048px, upload remains up to 10 MiB. GIFs only process the first frame. The website does not provide poetry genre, rhyming dictionary, or photo metadata preference settings; generation parameters use official default values.
docs.t036: Please download results in a timely manner
docs.t037: Server-side results are available for a limited time. To keep them long-term, please download the poetry text or sharing image; do not rely solely on staying on the page.
docs.t039: After the history feature is enabled, newly submitted and successful official tasks will be written to the account portfolio: compressed photos and poetry are retained for 90 days by default and can be permanently deleted early. Original images are not saved, and old tasks are not backfilled.
docs.t040: The works page supports paginated browsing, opening details, and viewing compressed photos and full poetry.
docs.t041: Details can generate and download pure poetry sharing images; a confirmation is required before permanent deletion.
docs.t042: When history is not yet enabled, the page will display a prompt 'History is not yet enabled'; current generation and downloads can still continue.
docs.t044: View credits and purchase as needed
docs.t045: The Personal Center displays email, verification status, daily free and cumulative remaining credits (including purchases and invitation gifts), as well as server-side packages and orders. Package prices come from the server; after placing an order, the Alipay desktop web payment or mobile web payment checkout will open.
docs.t046: Redirecting to payment does not equal successful arrival of funds; please refer to the order status and balance.
docs.t047: Unpaid orders can be reused with the same account, package, and payment method for a short time after creation, and will not be extended indefinitely.
docs.t048: Sessions are saved on the same-origin server, and the browser only holds the login cookie; you will need to log in again after a server restart or session expiration.
docs.t050: Website sharing images contain only poetry
docs.t051: Both creation results and work details can render PNGs in the browser. Sharing images adopt the paper color, border, and brand watermark, including the work title, lyric meter (cipai), and text, but do not include the original photo; a personal invitation QR code is attached to the white space below. After friends scan the code and successfully register, the inviter receives 3 creation opportunities. Rendering uses the Wenkai web font within the site; if a sharing image has not been generated yet, you can copy the poetry first and download it later from My Works.
docs.t053: Local creation, history, and photo saving
docs.t054: The client is suitable for users who wish to use self-hosted models, write results back to photos, or save complete history locally. The source code supports Android, iOS, HarmonyOS, Linux, macOS, and Windows; current public downloads are based on the Android official release, and other platforms depend on the release page status.
docs.t057: Select the installation package suitable for your device on the download page and check system requirements. Platforms not yet released will be clearly marked.
docs.t058: The Android client requires Android 8.0 or higher; saving copies to the system album requires Android 10 or higher. System versions, architectures, and installation methods for iOS, HarmonyOS, Linux, macOS, and Windows are subject to their respective release notes.
docs.t061: The client supports two generation methods; choose based on the actual entry in the settings:
docs.t063: Fill in the API key and Base URL provided by the model service, and select a visual model that supports image input after detecting available models. Detection only returns the model list and does not confirm whether the model supports images. Service availability and billing are determined by the service you configure.
docs.t065: When deploying and enabling official services, you can log in to your account or use a local guest identity to view available credits and submit official generations. Official services and custom models will not automatically switch after a failure.
docs.t066: First confirm where the photo will be sent
docs.t067: For custom models, the Base URL determines the service to which the request is sent; for official services, it is sent to the {brand} official backend and its model services. Please confirm that the address is trustworthy and keep your API key safe.
docs.t069: Choose an expression for the photo
docs.t070: After selecting a photo, preview it locally first, then start generation. Selecting an image itself does not invoke the model. Process one photo at a time.
docs.t072: You can select genres such as Jueju, Lushi, single lines, etc.
docs.t074: Create according to the lyric meter (Cipai).
docs.t076: Only generate photo titles, descriptions, and tags.
docs.t077: Read the results first after generation. Titles and text support copying; composition suggestions are displayed separately and are not written to image metadata. Metre and rhyming are creative guides and are not guaranteed to be strictly compliant. Android and HarmonyOS allow sharing single photos from the album to the App.
docs.t078: Save a copy, or choose to overwrite
docs.t079: Photo information can be written into metadata. Please choose the corresponding save method based on whether you need to keep the original image.
docs.t081: Save a copy of the photo with poetry, description, and tags, keeping the source file. Saving to the system album on Android requires Android 10 or higher.
docs.t083: On supported platforms and photo sources, explicitly select to update the original image metadata. Android only applies to parseable local gallery images and may require system authorization; Photo Picker or cloud sources may not be overwritable. HarmonyOS and iOS do not currently support overwriting; macOS overwrites the selected local file.
docs.t084: It is recommended to back up the original image before overwriting and verify the results after saving.
docs.t087: Search records in local history and open details to review created content; likes, favorites, trash, and recovery are supported.
docs.t089: Open the corresponding original image from the record; the original image must still exist and be accessible.
docs.t091: Organize local history. Records moved to the trash will be cleared when reading history after exceeding 30 days; deleting local records does not equal deleting data that may be retained by the model service.
docs.t093: Format existing poetry locally into images for saving and sharing; original photos are not included. Pure photo information results without poetry text cannot generate poetry sharing images.
docs.t094: Local history is not a cloud backup and will not automatically sync with the website portfolio. Before changing devices, clearing app data, or uninstalling, please back up the content you wish to keep.
docs.t095: Interface language and poetry characters are set separately
docs.t096: The client interface supports seven languages: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, and Thai.
docs.t097: Poetry text supports Simplified and Traditional Chinese, defaulting to Traditional. Interface language and poetry characters are set separately; switching the interface language does not automatically change poetry characters. The website currently fixes official generation to Simplified Chinese and does not provide this setting.
docs.t098: Local saving does not mean fully offline
docs.t099: Please understand 'where results are saved' and 'where generation requests are sent' separately. Both the website and client will send photo content to the corresponding service during generation.
docs.t101: After image selection, re-encode in the browser and remove EXIF; upload only occurs after clicking generate. The official service and its model services will receive the processed photos. After history is enabled, compressed photos and poetry will be retained on the server for 90 days; the browser will not write images or sharing images to local persistent storage.
docs.t103: The selected photo and content needed for generation will be sent to the model service you configured. Data retention, usage, and fees are determined by the policy of that service; please read and confirm before sending.
docs.t105: EXIF/GPS will be cleaned before uploading, then the official generation is submitted. This can reduce leakage of metadata such as location, but cannot eliminate personal information that may be contained in the photo image itself.
docs.t106: Local models and other network connections
docs.t107: Whether self-deployed visual models continue to call upstream depends on the deployment method. Android update checks, model detection, login, balance checks, and purchases may also connect to the network. Local history does not mean the application is completely offline.
docs.t109: Before sending a photo or sharing a PNG, confirm the text, image, and metadata scope you are willing to make public. Sharing images from both the website and client do not include the original photo, but still contain the poetry text you confirmed.
